detailed_descriptions.en: Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will fight through six mysterious dungeons, each with their own unique themes and puzzles, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this Zelda-inspired adventure. Use your fairy companion’s magic to duplicate and spawn a variety of objects in the world, and discover how they interact with your robust set of items to solve head-scratching puzzles. EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS Eight different biomes in the overworld. Seven different dungeons, each with their own unique theme, mechanics, and key item. COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS Use Lief's fairy companion to copy and spawn a myriad of objects, using them to solve puzzles and fight terrifying enemies. FORGE A COMMUNITY Construct various buildings and forge a township. Characters that Lief saves throughout the game will move to the township, offering new quests and stories. DUNGEON CRAWL WITH A FRIEND Play through TWO separate multiplayer stages with a friend, either in local co-op or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Take control of an owl named Lief as they make a pilgrimage skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries, where it's said that any wish can be granted. Players will fight through six mysterious dungeons, each with their own unique themes and puzzles, and meet charming anthropomorphic characters along the way in this Zelda-inspired adventure.

Use your fairy companion’s magic to duplicate and spawn a variety of objects in the world, and discover how they interact with your robust set of items to solve head-scratching puzzles.

EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS

Eight different biomes in the overworld. Seven different dungeons, each with their own unique theme, mechanics, and key item.

COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS

Use Lief's fairy companion to copy and spawn a myriad of objects, using them to solve puzzles and fight terrifying enemies.

FORGE A COMMUNITY

Construct various buildings and forge a township. Characters that Lief saves throughout the game will move to the township, offering new quests and stories.

DUNGEON CRAWL WITH A FRIEND

Play through TWO separate multiplayer stages with a friend, either in local co-op or online via Steam Remote Play Together.
